_doc: CmuxNextApp move plan from scripts/cmux-next/app-graph.py (p11-codebase task 000a). Regenerate with `app-graph.py --write` (regex) or `--index-store PATH --write` (fleet Debug build); never hand-edit. groups: destination, host_members (Type.member the group reaches through its Host), deps, cuts (reason app = into the composition root, upward = up the layer order or into a higher tier, gated = from ungated work into an owner-gated group, cycle = would close a package cycle), scc_id (component of the uncut graph, root edges aside), order (index into `order`; the composition root has the last index). order: move units leaf-first, one seam commit plus one move commit each; task is the unit's Q1 task id (tasks: id -> its one entry; families: task-table row -> entries), waits_on the owner gates it or a unit it needs waits for. destinations: final dependency list per target. new_targets: what task 007 creates. provisional: true until the facts come from an index store (the regex scan guesses variable types file-wide, so host_members, cut weights and deps are approximate); task 007 lands final deps only from a non-provisional plan.

CmuxNextHomeFeatures.why: HomeEngine and HostedChief depend on CmuxNextHome, and the Home glue imports both

CmuxNextPaletteSources.why: the palette sources read AgentTabs, SidebarFeatures, BrowserFeatures and other features, and those features depend on the CmuxNextPalette kit

CmuxNextSidebarFeatures.why: Bridge depends on CmuxNextSidebar, and the Sidebar glue imports Bridge
